message: ドッキリは高難度
--Three days left until parting with Lolotte.

name: Misa
message: 「Got it? Keep it casual. Casual!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Give it a rest. She's gonna see right through it anyway.」

name: Ria
message: 「Now, now\s02」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm baack~~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh? Everyone, are you finished already?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah. Everything's pretty much cleaned up.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In that case, all that's left is to wait for the big day~~. I'm so excited~~\s07」

name: Misa
message: 「Well then, Sakura-kun. We'll be heading out ahead of you.」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun. Just because you two are all alone doesn't mean you can do anything naughty in the Student Council room, okay♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Pfft!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wh-What's with that reaction just now!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-It's nothing at all!\s01」

name: Misa
message: 「Come on, Nanaka-san. Let's go!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Heehee... Thank you everyone, for going out of your way like that♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha... So you figured it out after all, huh.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We were separated during the Holy Night Festival preparations, after all. So, even if it's just a little like this...」
Lolotte snuggles up close.

name: Lolotte
message: 「I want some time where the two of us can be alone together...\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte... Um...」

name: Synn
message: 「Can I hold your hand?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Um... What's the matter, acting so formal? Haven't we always held hands?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「C―Could it be―?! Are there other ways to hold hands?!」

name: Synn
message: 「N―No, that's not it―」
Urgh! Act natural, act natural.

name: Synn
message: 「Um... uh, right! I'm going to do a good-luck charm to make us happy!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh!!」
As long as I do it just like Misa taught me, it'll be fine.

name: Synn
message: 「Right here, I have a piece of red yarn!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehh?!」

name: Synn
message: 「I wrap it around our fingers like this...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「N-No way, Mr. President...」

name: Synn
message: 「And mark the knot with a pen...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, don't look! If you look, you'll get bad luck!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eeeek!」

name: Synn
message: 「There... all done!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, shall we walk home together?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehh?! With the yarn still wrapped around us?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Look, it's wrapped around me too! Ta-da!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I don't quite understand, but... this means we'll both become happy, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, exactly!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Phew... I'm relieved. I thought for sure you were going to--」

name: Synn
message: 「Going to what?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Awawa!\s01 It's nothing at aaall!」

name: Synn
message: 「...Though, we can only stay together until the school gate.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm sorry... There's something I simply must do today...」

name: Synn
message: 「It's fine, really. Don't worry about it. I actually had an errand to run too」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is that so」
I've got to keep my part-time job a secret.
I'm going to give Lolotte a big surprise.

name: Synn
message: 「About going back. Have you told your family yet?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. Though I made a firm promise to them that I would come back」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Grandfather and Grandmother said they'd feel a little lonely... but they forgave me with a smile...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「They told me to take care and have a safe trip」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. That's great」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes!」

name: Synn
message: 「What did Riesling say?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Jiiya...」

name: Riesling
message: 「Welcome back, my lady」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Jiiya!」

name: Riesling
message: 「My lady. The thread tied around your finger has come undone」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, oh!」
My carefully laid plan is ruined!!

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President, won't this ruin the good-luck charm for happiness...?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, that's, um...」

name: Riesling
message: 「There are also charms whose wishes come true when they unravel on their own. Please rest assured」
It's a bit different from a promise ring, though... Nice save!
Still, I couldn't see my goal through to the end, huh.

name: Synn
message: 「Did you hear from Lolotte about her returning to Heaven?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Of course, I have been informed」

name: Riesling
message: 「Even I am unable to accompany her all the way to Heaven, however...」

name: Riesling
message: 「For whenever you close your eyes, I shall always be with you」

name: Riesling
message: 「It is the duty of this humble Riesling Toyama to keep your room spotless and have your meals prepared so that you may return at any time, my lady」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Jiiya...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... He's acting tough, but truth is he's so lonely he can't stand it」
Fluttering down, a single slip of paper dances before my eyes.
The instant I involuntarily catch my breath at its slow, drifting motion--

name: Paqy
message: 「Shing!!」
A toy knife pierced right through the slip of paper and stuck into Paqy's round button.
Looking closely, it's shaped like a walkie-talkie... What the heck is this.

name: Riesling
message: 「Master Synn. Please take good care of yourself and do not push yourself too hard」
Written on the paper are several numbers, along with measurements.
Could these possibly be Lolotte's--!?

name: Riesling
message: 「Well then, please excuse me」

name: Synn
message: 「Riesling-san... thank you so much!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, Lolotte... see you tomorrow」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes♪ See you tomorrow. Goodbye」
Lolotte toddles off toward the car alongside Riesling-san.
I watch them go. Just when I thought Lolotte had turned around to wave goodbye again--

name: Lolotte
message: 「President♪」
A sudden ambush kiss!?

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hey... right here?! Besides, Riesling-san is watching, isn't he!\s03」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's quite alright. After all, we are officially recognized now」

name: Riesling
message: 「Ahem, ahem, ahem!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha...\s03」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Until I return to Heaven, I want to be together even a little longer. I want to kiss you as much as I can」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte...」
With a gentle tap, we press our foreheads together.
Rubbing the tips of our noses together, we share another kiss.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mnh... chuu, pfuhaa...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「...I wish time would just stop like this forever...」

name: Synn
message: 「If that happened, what would you do when you got hungry?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Jeez. I'm not that much of a glutton」

name: Synn
message: 「Less of a glutton, more of a spoiled clingy girl」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then I'd rather just be a spoiled clingy girl...\s04」
Just like that, the two of them held each other there for as long as time allowed.
